Package edu.ucalgary.oop

Class VeterinaryClinic

java.lang.Object
edu.ucalgary.oop.VeterinaryClinic
public class VeterinaryClinic extends Object
Coordinates in-memory clinic data with the PostgreSQL database.

    • scheduleAppointment

      public Appointment scheduleAppointment(Pet pet, Veterinarian veterinarian, LocalDateTime dateTime, String notes) throws AppointmentSchedulingException, SQLException
      Schedules an appointment in memory and then stores it in PostgreSQL. If the database insert fails, the in-memory appointment is removed again so the two stores remain consistent.
      Parameters:
      pet - pet being seen
      veterinarian - assigned veterinarian
      dateTime - appointment date/time
      notes - notes
      Returns:
      scheduled appointment
      Throws:
      AppointmentSchedulingException - when a clinic scheduling rule is violated
      SQLException - when the database insert fails
